uncited: The family shares the goal of mapping chromatic properties from a reference image $R$ to a target image or volume $T$ while preserving the structural content of $T$.
The specific mechanism, parameters, and mathematical formulation vary by child method.

Common steps include feature extraction, correspondence or statistical matching, color transfer filtering, and volumetric mapping where RGB channels are assigned to voxels and opacity is derived from target luminance.
Input consists of the rerendered image $S$ (generated by splatting voxels onto the image plane) plus the light position as an additional channel.
